$comment: Invoice boilerplate — the terms around the calculated line-item table, which the engine renders separately (see invoice-math.mjs and the invoice-specific block in renderDoc). No clause here quotes a party role in curly quotes, on purpose: an invoice signs no one and needs no defined-term pair for terminology.mjs to check, so the simplest way to avoid that whole class of bug is not to introduce one. Drafting only, jurisdiction-neutral; sales tax applicability and rate are the user's to determine, never asserted here.

clauses.title: Invoice Details
clauses.rationale: The invoice number and due date, stated once in prose above the calculated table — the table itself only carries the line items and totals. Included when the wizard's optional invoice number is filled in.
clauses.body: Invoice {{invoiceNumber}} from {{company}} to {{counterparty}}, dated {{date}}. Payment is due: {{dueText}}.

clauses.title: Invoice Details
clauses.rationale: The no-invoice-number variant — most freelancers and small businesses don't number every invoice, and the sentence should read cleanly either way rather than leaving a blank where a number would go.
clauses.body: Invoice from {{company}} to {{counterparty}}, dated {{date}}. Payment is due: {{dueText}}.

clauses.title: How to Pay
clauses.rationale: Offered rather than automatic — accepted payment methods vary by who is billing, and a blank left for the user beats a guess.
clauses.body: Payment is accepted by: [bank transfer, check, card, or however {{company}} actually gets paid]. Include this invoice number or the client name as a reference with any payment.

clauses.title: Late Payments
clauses.rationale: Offered, not automatic: a late fee is a real economic choice, and some places cap how large it may be — checking that locally is the user's job, not this template's.
clauses.body: Amounts unpaid [15] days after the due date bear a late charge of [amount or percentage] per month, to the extent the amount and method are lawful where this invoice is sent.

clauses.title: Questions About This Invoice
clauses.rationale: Gives a dispute a place to go before it becomes a late payment — cheap to include, genuinely useful.
clauses.body: Questions about any line on this invoice should be raised within [10] days of the invoice date, to [name, email, or phone].

clauses.title: Thank You
clauses.rationale: Costs nothing, and small businesses often want it — entirely optional.
